subject: Live walkthrough blocked by vendor-portal approval — propose recorded demo + follow-up Q&A
messages:
From: Ivy Walls <ivy.walls@harbormed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@harbormed.com, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@harbormed.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live walkthrough request for Redwood — procurement gating

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the invite. We’re excited to see Redwood in action, but a heads-up from procurement: we can’t host a live executive walkthrough until the vendor portal onboarding is complete. Legal needs the signed mutual NDA and the completed vendor security questionnaire (SOC2 attestation + KMS handling), and our IT team needs the SSO/IDP scoping details.

I attached the questionnaire our vendor team requires. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the SOC2 evidence and sample KMS flow, and whether you support SAML 2.0 IdP metadata exchange?

If a live meeting is still required for execs, procurement has asked to wait ~2–3 weeks while they finish intake. Otherwise, we’d be open to an on-demand recording and a follow-up Q&A session with a narrower technical audience.

Best,
Ivy Walls
Director, Strategic Procurement — HarborMed
[attachment: HarborMed_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Walls <ivy.walls@harbormed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live walkthrough request for Redwood — procurement gating

Hi Ivy —

Appreciate the clarity and the questionnaire — that’s helpful. We can provide SOC2 reports, a short write-up on our KMS integrations (we support customer-managed keys through standard KMS/HSM providers), and SAML 2.0 metadata for SSO. I’ll attach the short KMS doc and a SOC2 summary next.

Given procurement’s timeline, two options from our side:
- Option A (live, but delayed): keep the executive walkthrough on the calendar and move it out 2–3 weeks so procurement can finish intake.
- Option B (asynchronous): we record a 20–25 minute executive-focused demo (no production data), share it with your execs, and schedule a 45–60 minute live Q&A with our security/solutions engineers for the technical stakeholders once intake is complete.

If Option B works for you we can get the recording to you within 48 hours and include a short checklist that maps question-by-question to the vendor questionnaire you sent.

Quick ask for our ops team (Ben/Hannah): can you prepare the SOC2 summary + KMS one-pager and an initial draft of the questionnaire mapping today?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[attachment: Redwood_KMS_overview.pdf (pdf)]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live walkthrough request for Redwood — procurement gating

Marissa —

On it. Hannah and I pulled the SOC2 cert and I’m attaching a one‑pager for the KMS flow; we can map the HarborMed questionnaire to our artifacts by EOD. We do support SAML 2.0 and can provide test metadata for their IDP team to consume.

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, KMS_integration-onepager.pdf (stubs)

I also recommend flagging a small follow-up session for 1 hour with their security engineer and our solutions engineer — better than a long exec call for technical onboarding.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf); attachment: KMS_integration-onepager.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ivy Walls <ivy.walls@harbormed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@harbormed.com, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@harbormed.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live walkthrough request for Redwood — procurement gating

Thanks, Marissa and Ben — this all looks promising. Procurement will continue intake but we’re happy to take the recorded demo + mapping in the interim.

Two asks before we circulate to execs: 1) can you confirm the recording will contain no customer data and will show only redacted/example traces, and 2) include a 1–page mapping (questionnaire => artifact) so our vendor team can tick boxes quickly.

If you can get the recording and mapping by EOD tomorrow (Fri) we’ll share it with the execs over the weekend and set a tentative 60‑minute technical Q&A for the week of Sep 11.

Best,
Ivy

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Walls <ivy.walls@harbormed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live walkthrough request for Redwood — procurement gating

Ivy —

Confirmed: the recording will be fully synthetic/redacted and will never include customer PII or production tokens. Ben attached the SOC2 summary; Hannah and I have completed the questionnaire mapping. I uploaded the demo recording and the one‑page mapping to a shared Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cDemoChecklist
HubSpot: HS-90342 (I updated the timeline and next steps)

Proposed next steps:
- We’ll share the recorded demo + mapping now.
- Procurement reviews over the weekend.
- Tentative 60‑minute technical Q&A week of Sep 11 (we’ll send a Doodle for availability).

Thanks for the flexibility — we’ll keep the live exec slot tentative for now and confirm once intake clears.

Warmly,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_demo-recording-link.txt (text)]
